additional_info.subject: 0407093 - ID0406839-DC/Si-D/RO[170000128] - DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101-(C1) CRM:00314000146
additional_info.body:
Dear Traian,
I am reaching out regarding child ticket
ID0407093,
opened for DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101 on charger
cQKZW3.
I had a quick look at the charger behavior over the last month (from 1st February 2025), and these are my findings:
#24 activation of the error flag “
PLC-Error-Flag 'DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101' changed to true - (VIV:0 PLE:1 KON:1)”, where:
VIV:0 → in case of an invalid sensor reading
PLE:1→ in case of an plausibility error (temperature difference between +/- 15 deg C too high)
KON:1: → in case the contact temperature sensors are not okay
The CableTempSensor issue in #10 cases brought to a charging interruption on DC2:
#2 times on 08.02.2025
#1 time on 13.02.2025
#2 rimes on 14.02.2025
#5 times on 15.02.2025
Since then, no other appearance of the error flag. The issue is therefore not permanent and not recurring daily.
I do not see at the moment a clear reason to replace the cable. What can be done is to go onsite and check the plug. In particular, please check the status of the pins of the plug and the connector mating surface. Please check if dust or dirt is inside the fins of the plug, or if the fins are bent/broken. All these points might reduce the contact surface or create hotspots, resulting in CableTempSensor issue.
Please be aware that this ticket is related to an
out of warranty charger
. I will therefore close this child case and redirect you in the parent ticket to my colleague from NOC Team for the handling of out of warranty case, if further support on this ticket is required from your side!
